## Summary

Describe the user-visible or technical change.

## Validation

- [ ] Shell syntax checks pass.
- [ ] ShellCheck passes for changed scripts.
- [ ] Installer smoke tests pass.
- [ ] libfprint build and relevant unit tests pass.
- [ ] Hardware tests are recorded separately from build/test results.

## System integration impact

- [ ] Installer and uninstaller behavior were both reviewed.
- [ ] Existing files and package-manager settings are preserved when prior state is unknown.
- [ ] No broad device permissions, automatic PAM edits, or package holds were added.
- [ ] Failure paths retain a working stock library or a documented recovery path.
- [ ] Documentation and release limitations are updated.

## Hardware test evidence

If hardware was tested, include the exact USB ID, laptop, firmware (if known), distribution, kernel, and test outcome. Do not attach fingerprint images or biometric templates.
